title: Compile the common twirl with bounded local randomness and paid padding
statement: Prepare one known highest-weight GT label after retaining multiplicity, then apply one common finite U(dprime) design to all copies. A bounded-bit Box-Muller/polar local U4 sampler is coupled to Haar in channel error, never claimed close in total variation. Paid arithmetic/root isolation handles repeated roots; bounded location retries have physicalfallback. BHH Corollary6and compatible-basis Schur inputs give uniform polynomial gates in t,d,log D and precision. The finite diagnostic does not implement the full certified compiler.
